kitDescription: Grave is a Fire AR Supporter (Burst II) built around two alternating self states. Her burst puts her in Prediction for 10 seconds: unlimited ammo, she gains Pierce, and she gets a big self Critical Rate and Pierce Damage boost, while the whole team gets Attack Damage, Pierce Damage and +3 magazine rounds for the same 10 seconds (she pays 1% current HP per second). When Prediction ends she dumps her whole magazine and enters Heat Emission, her default state for most of the fight, where her reloads are much slower but the team continuously gets faster Burst Gauge generation and more Pierce Damage, and she trickle-heals herself. Alongside that, landing normal attacks stacks an Overheat ramp: 15 hits give her an ATK buff (lost when she reloads to full), and while in Prediction, 30 and 60 landed attacks add a further ATK buff and an Attack Damage buff. In practice she is a team enabler whose personal damage rides on the 10-second Prediction burst window, and whose slow reload is a real damage cost between windows.

redAssertions: ATTRIBUTED-RECON_ERROR (fixture burst starvation, ~19 assertions): the blind used controlComp('grave', true) = liter/crown/grave/helm, in which crown and grave are BOTH Burst II and crown wins the B2 slot every chain, so grave casts 0 bursts. Every burst-gated assertion (unlimitedAmmo removal + 180s duration, hasPierce whole-fight patch, gainPierce duration, self critRatePct 85.19 present/self/10s, self pierceDamagePct 52.8, ally attackDamagePct 48.2 reach + bucket, maxAmmoFlat present + shot-economy, ally pierceDamagePct 39.98, Overheat II 20.66, Overheat III 30.8 present + bucket + ordering) sees zero applications and fails vacuously. The driver's liter/grave/ada/helm fixture produces 12 grave bursts; the blind's own baseline non-vacuity assertion ('burstCast exists') is the tell.

ATTRIBUTED-RECON_ERROR (schema, every counterfactual): the blind patches ov.skill1.blocks / ov.skill2.blocks / ov.burst.blocks, but the live OverrideFile schema is a FLAT ARRAY per slot (ov.skill1 IS the array — cf. the driver test's ov.skill1.filter / ov.burst.flatMap and crown.test.ts). Those accesses are undefined, so the patches throw or silently no-op; the resulting RED asserts nothing about the driver's encoding.

GENUINE DIVERGENCE 1 — 'Reload Ratio 50% DOWN is a NEGATIVE reloadSpeedPct' + its sign-flip counterfactual: the driver ships no reloadSpeedPct buff, it ships the MEASURED charFixes.reloadFrames 193 (effective 201f, grave solo.MP4 n=19). The literal encoding is refuted by measurement in the driver note (reloadSpeedPct -50 -> 131f, far too fast vs the measured 201f gap). Driver is measured-superior; blind is literal-but-wrong-magnitude.

GENUINE DIVERGENCE 2 — 'Overheat I is removeOnReload, NOT a wall-clock buff' (asserts a buffRemove with cause 'reload'): the driver models Overheat I as a sustained hitCount-15 buff and lists the removal clause VERBATIM in unmodeled.skill2 as a documented hand approximation. Documented, bounded over-credit; the primitive exists, so this is the one residual that is enactable today (see gotchas).

SPURIOUS — 'the Heat-Emission heal emits recovery events / removing it must move totals': the driver drops the self-heal with a reviewed rationale (the recovery event fires on the RECEIVER = grave, who has no on-recovery trigger, so unlike Helm->Crown it cannot feed a teammate). The blind's own counterfactual is also a no-op against the shipped file (no heal effect to strip), so the assertion is unfalsifiable as written.

skill1.driverSaid: unmodeled.skill1 verbatim; no engine effect can EMPTY a magazine (instantReload only ADDS; fraction 0 is a no-op) and no Prediction-end trigger exists (fullBurstEnd would over-fire on FBs she did not produce)
skill1.blindSaid: S6 encoded consumeAmmo fraction 1 on fullBurstEnd + ownBurstGate 'cast'; S5 it.skip'd it as a missing trigger primitive
skill1.formulaCheck: Effect is shot-count (damage-gating), not a bucket entry; direction is a COST, so omitting it over-credits by ~9-11 forced 201f reloads/fight in comps
skill1.explanation: n/a (deliberately unmodeled). Real primitive gap on the trigger side; S6's fullBurstEnd+ownBurstGate synthesis is a defensible proxy but fires at FB end, not Prediction end, and the driver's stated objection (over-fire on non-grave FBs) is only partly answered by ownBurstGate. Documented verbatim + in caveats + tracked in open-questions U19. Direction of the omission is over-credit, consistent with the board HOT.

skill1.driverSaid: charFixes.reloadFrames 193 -> reloadFramesNeeded(193,0)=round(193*0.975)+13=201f, reproducing the MEASURED 3.35s/201f gap (n=19 clean reloads, 2.85-3.52s); composes correctly with any real reload-speed buff
skill1.blindSaid: S5+S6 both encoded the literal reloadSpeedPct -50 on the datamined 81f base (S6 itself flagging the datamine 'known-unreliable'); S2b hypothesised a refill-FRACTION reading instead
skill1.formulaCheck: reloadFrames is wall-clock reload; effective = round(base*0.975)+13 at 0 reload-speed buff — the driver's arithmetic is exact, and a measured charFixes.reloadFrames explicitly OVERRIDES the datamined value per the SSOT
skill1.explanation: Both blinds' literal encoding lands at 131f, ~35% too fast vs the measured 201f, and S2b's refill-fraction reading is refuted by the observed 61.5 shots/gap = full 60-round mags. Measured behaviour is the ground truth for this subsystem; the charFixes route also composes with real reload-speed buffs where a fake reloadSpeedPct would not. The mechanism ATTRIBUTION ('v50% + overhead' vs 'datamine simply wrong') is unfalsifiable here — she only ever reloads in Heat Emission — and the driver states exactly that caveat rather than asserting the narrative. Not a fidelity gotcha: the named mechanic's only observable is the reload gap, and that gap is reproduced at its measured value.

skill1.kitLine: Removes Heat Emission under certain cond
skill1.driverSaid: unmodeled verbatim — condition unspecified in kit
skill1.blindSaid: S6 HYPOTHESISED the condition is reloading to max (sibling Overheat I wording) and derived a 2.7s Heat Emission window from it; S2b called it measurement-gated and load-bearing
skill1.formulaCheck: Sets team-block uptime; unbounded in any faithful reading of the prose alone
skill1.explanation: n/a (unmodeled). The prose genuinely does not state the condition, so UNMODELED + verbatim is the correct honest disposition; S6's derived 2.7s window is an unmeasured chain of two estimates (it inherits the datamined 81f the driver measured away) and would be a worse model, not a better one. S2b's own hypothesis (removal at next burst cast, so 48.4 never reaches grave) is exactly what the shipped excludeSelf achieves.

skill1.kitLine: Heat Emission: Recovers 2% Max HP / 1 sec
skill1.driverSaid: unmodeled verbatim — SELF-target; the recovery event fires on the RECEIVER (grave), who has no on-recovery trigger, so it can never feed a teammate; no periodic-trigger kind exists to encode it
skill1.blindSaid: S6 encoded heal ticks:3 intervalSec:1; S5 asserted removing it must move team totals (tandem/cross-unit channel)
skill1.formulaCheck: Not a damage bucket; v1 models no HP pool and the boss deals no damage, so healing has no offensive or survival consequence
skill1.explanation: n/a (unmodeled). Hard-rule-2 (never drop a heal that drives a teammate's recovery consumer) is the right instinct and the blind was right to probe it, but it does not bite for a SELF-target heal under this engine's receiver-side event model. S2b independently agreed this is genuinely inert. Owner spot-check: this is the one call that rests on an engine-behaviour claim (recovery events fire receiver-side) rather than on prose.

skill1.driverSaid: passive -> allies (incl self), burstGenPct 38.96, no expiry
skill1.blindSaid: S5 converged on burstGenPct 38.96 to ALL allies incl self; S6 converged on stat+value but windowed it to a derived 2.7s on fullBurstEnd
skill1.formulaCheck: burstGenPct is a rotation-cadence stat, not a damage bucket; 'continuously' = no durationSec; 'Affects all allies' includes self per SSOT
skill1.explanation: Stat, magnitude, target set and permanence all match the prose. Applied at frame 0 to all four allies with expiresFrame null and durationShots null (driver G1), so it fires as a state, not a timed buff. The Heat-Emission GATE on this block is the separate documented approximation below.

skill1.driverSaid: passive -> allies with excludeSelf, pierceDamagePct 48.4 — grave-self can never benefit (she is pierce-tagged only in Prediction, when Heat Emission is OFF), so excludeSelf gives her the faithful zero AND blocks a burst-window double-count
skill1.blindSaid: S5+S6 both encoded plain allies (no excludeSelf); S2b's removal-condition hypothesis independently predicts grave never receives it
skill1.formulaCheck: pierceDamagePct is a Damage-Up entry, additive with attackDamagePct then x(1+sum/100), live ONLY on pierce-tagged attacks — so it is inert on non-pierce teammates and would be LIVE on grave during her gainPierce window
skill1.explanation: excludeSelf is not a target-set error, it is the correct compensation for modelling a Heat-Emission-gated line as an always-on passive: the only frames on which grave herself could consume pierceDamagePct are exactly the Prediction frames on which Heat Emission is OFF, so her true entitlement is zero and the shipped encoding delivers zero. S2b reached the same endpoint from an independent hypothesis. Residual to carry: if a self-status gate primitive ever lands, excludeSelf MUST be removed with it or the compensation becomes a real under-credit.

skill1.driverSaid: caveats: team buffs 'modeled as always-on passive — real uptime excludes the ~10s Prediction windows after her burst'
skill1.blindSaid: S5 it.skip: schema has requiresTargetStatus (boss-only) and no self-status equivalent -> passives are the only expressible form; S2b called the windowed model a FIX but conceded no status-end trigger exists
skill1.formulaCheck: Over-credits the ally burstGen/pierce lines by up to ~10s per burst cycle (~12 cycles); on the 48.4 the excludeSelf already zeroes grave's own share, so the over-credit is ally-side only and inert on non-pierce allies
skill1.explanation: Genuine missing primitive (no self-status gate, no status-end trigger), bounded, documented in both the note and caveats, and independently corroborated by BOTH blinds as primitive-blocked. Per S4 this is a residual, not NO-GO(engine-core): it is not an anchor line and the measured solo anchor (1.005) is unaffected since a lone Burst II never bursts, so Heat Emission is never interrupted there.

skill2.blindSaid: S5+S6 both converged on hitCount:15 / self / atkPct 15.48 (both adding removeOnReload)
skill2.formulaCheck: atkPct is the ATK bucket (multiplies sheet ATK before boss-DEF-subtracted baseAtk); trigger/target/magnitude all match prose
skill2.explanation: Fires at frame > 0 and strictly before her first burst cast (driver G4), so it is genuinely hitCount-driven rather than a frame-0 passive. Structural pin confirms trigger.count 15, target self, atkPct 15.48. Three independent derivations agree on every field.

skill2.kitLine: Removed upon reloading to max ammo
skill2.driverSaid: unmodeled.skill2 verbatim — 'absorbed by the sustained hitCount-15 approximation, hand decision'
skill2.blindSaid: S5 asserted removeOnReload with a buffRemove cause 'reload'; S6 encoded removeOnReload:true — i.e. BOTH blinds used the primitive
skill2.formulaCheck: With a 60-round mag, the buff is stripped every reload and re-earned 15 hits later, so real uptime is ~45/60 = ~75% of her non-Prediction shots; the sustained model over-credits ~15.48% ATK on the remaining ~25%
skill2.explanation: Documented verbatim, so not a gotcha — but it is the ONE residual on this unit that is NOT primitive-blocked: removeOnReload exists in the schema and both blinds reached for it unprompted. Direction is over-credit, matching the board's 1.104 HOT. Listed in gotchas at low severity as an enactable owner item, not as a faithfulness defect.

skill2.kitLine: 30 att, in Prediction: Overheat II ATK +20.66%
skill2.driverSaid: burstCast -> self, atkPct 20.66, durationSec 10 (= the Prediction window)
skill2.blindSaid: S6 encoded cumulative hitCount:30 + fbGate 'inFb' + ownBurstGate 'cast' (own caveat: hitCount is cumulative from battle start, so 30 is a PROXY); S2b read 'continuously' as PERMANENT once earned
skill2.formulaCheck: atkPct = ATK bucket; the prose gate 'While in Prediction and Overheat I status' is an ACTIVE gate, so the buff must die with Prediction — the driver's 10s durationSec encodes exactly that
skill2.explanation: The driver's reading beats both blinds here. S2b's 'permanent once earned' ignores the explicit 'While in Prediction' gate and would over-credit the entire out-of-window fight; S6's cumulative hitCount:30 is satisfied within seconds of battle start and so degenerates to the same full-window behaviour the driver ships, minus the clean 10s expiry. Verified firing: applied on the exact first burst frame, once per burst (12 applications), self-only, expiresFrame - frame == 600.

skill2.blindSaid: S5+S6 both explicitly flagged attackDamagePct (Damage-Up), NOT atkPct — full three-way convergence on the bucket
skill2.formulaCheck: 'Attack Damage' is the Damage-Up bucket (additive with pierceDamagePct etc., then x(1+sum/100)); 'ATK' is the multiplicative ATK bucket. Conflating them is the canonical nearest-wrong and all three derivations avoided it
skill2.explanation: Bucket, magnitude, target and 10s Prediction gate all correct. Fires once per burst (12), self-only, 600-frame window.

skill2.driverSaid: caveats + note flag 3: build-up approximated as full 10s window uptime; at the measured 12.0 rounds/s under unlimited ammo the real ramp is ~2.5s / ~5.0s, so durationSec 7.5 / 5.0 would equal the real in-window uptime — recorded as a FINDING on the hand slot, deliberately not edited
skill2.blindSaid: S6 raised the identical concern (in-window arrival frame will not match the real 30th/60th landed attack); S5 it.skip'd the Prediction-scoped counter as inexpressible
skill2.formulaCheck: Over-credits atkPct 20.66 for ~25% and attackDamagePct 30.8 for ~50% of her highest-damage window — a leading candidate for the isolated burst-window HOT residual
skill2.explanation: Honest, quantified, self-derived flag with a recipe — exactly the DOCUMENTED_GAP shape. One correction for whoever enacts it: shortening durationSec to 7.5/5.0 preserves the uptime INTEGRAL but not the ALIGNMENT — the real buff starts late, the shortened one ends early, and damage is not uniform across the window (Full Burst major, unlimited-ammo cadence). A start-delay primitive, or a hitCount trigger scoped to the window, is the faithful fix; the 7.5/5.0 haircut is a second-best approximation.

burst.blindSaid: S5+S6 both skipped it for the same reason (v1 has no HP pool, boss deals no damage, self-drain unobservable)
burst.formulaCheck: No damage-bucket consequence; no survival consequence in a no-HP-pool v1
burst.explanation: n/a (unmodeled). Unanimous across all three derivations; correctly recorded as skipped-not-ignored.

burst.formulaCheck: unlimitedAmmo{durationSec} = no reloads in window; burstCast = her OWN cast (not fullBurstEnter), which is what 'Affects self' on her burst means
burst.explanation: Verified firing rather than merely present: every shot inside her first 10s window carries unlimitedAmmo=true and she fires >=100 shots in-window (driver G6); stripping it drops in-window shots as she burns the 60-round mag against the measured 201f reload. This is also the block that makes the measured slow reload harmless inside the window, which is why the reload fix moved comps far less than solo.

burst.driverSaid: burstCast -> self, gainPierce durationSec 10; hasPierce deliberately NOT set
burst.blindSaid: S5 ('timed gainPierce EFFECT, not the static hasPierce flag') and S6 ('hasPierce is deliberately FALSE') both converged independently
burst.formulaCheck: SSOT: a unit is pierce-tagged whole-fight via hasPierce:true OR for a window via gainPierce{durationSec}; pierceDamagePct feeds Damage-Up ONLY while pierce-tagged. Whole-fight hasPierce would let 52.8 + 39.98 (+48.4 if excludeSelf were dropped) feed every shot of the fight
burst.explanation: Three-way convergence on the harder of the two encodings. Verified as load-bearing, not decorative: stripping gainPierce collapses her in-window Damage-Up (probe: 2.72/3.00 -> 1.79/2.07). This is the line the owner enabled knowing it would move comps ~0.83 -> ~1.18 — faithful over fit — and the judge concurs that is the correct call: the mechanic is real, and the surviving HOT is a separately-tracked over-model, not evidence against the pierce.

burst.formulaCheck: Damage-Up bucket, additive with the ally 39.98 (total +92.78 in-window); live because gainPierce tags her for exactly the same 10s
burst.explanation: Self-only, 12 applications (once per burst), expiresFrame - frame == 600. Correctly paired with gainPierce so the buff is never live on untagged frames.

burst.blindSaid: S5 and S6 both explicitly flagged UNSCOPED critRatePct, not critRateNormalPct — and S5 added a negative assertion that no 85.19 critRateNormalPct exists
burst.formulaCheck: SSOT: 'Critical Rate' unscoped = generic critRatePct; 'Critical Rate of normal attacks' = critRateNormalPct. The prose carries no qualifier. critRate caps at 1.0
burst.explanation: Three-way convergence including the scope trap. Verified behaviourally: in-window resolved crit rate is exactly 1.0 (capped) and drops to 0.15/0.30 with the buff stripped (driver G6) — note the cap means part of the 85.19 is wasted, which is faithful to the game, not a modelling shortcut.

burst.blindSaid: S5 and S6 both: attackDamagePct NOT atkPct, all allies INCLUDING self
burst.formulaCheck: Damage-Up bucket, additive with other Damage-Up sources then x(1+sum/100) — materially different from the multiplicative atkPct in a comp carrying liter/helm buffs
burst.explanation: Reaches all four slots including grave herself, 12 applications per target, 600-frame windows. Bucket and target-set both survive the nearest-wrong (atkPct) counterfactual.

burst.blindSaid: identical in S5 and S6, both noting it is inert on non-pierce-tagged teammates
burst.formulaCheck: Damage-Up entry gated on the RECEIVER being pierce-tagged; correctly inert for allies without pierce, live for grave herself during her gainPierce window
burst.explanation: All four targets, once per burst, 10s. Correctly distinct from the self 52.8 line rather than merged into one magnitude.

burst.driverSaid: burstCast -> allies, maxAmmoFlat 3, durationSec 10 (kit-literal flat rounds; enacted 2026-07-20, replacing a near-inert maxAmmoPct 3 proxy)
burst.blindSaid: S5 ('FLAT rounds; maxAmmoPct is the nearest-wrong') and S6 ('FLAT rounds, not maxAmmoPct') both converged
burst.formulaCheck: SSOT: 'X round(s)' as a MAGNITUDE on max ammo = flat value, not a duration and not a percentage; 'for 10 sec' is the durationSec. The driver got both halves of that distinction right
burst.explanation: Structurally pinned (maxAmmoFlat 3 present, maxAmmoPct absent) and behaviourally live — materially larger for small-magazine SG/SR teammates than the old +3% proxy, which is why the A/B was recorded in DECISIONS. Faithful over fit, again.

burst.kitLine: burst trigger: her OWN cast, not team FB
burst.driverSaid: trigger.kind burstCast on both burst blocks (and on Overheat II/III)
burst.blindSaid: S5 and S6 both explicitly rejected fullBurstEnter in favour of burstCast
burst.formulaCheck: SSOT: burstCast = the unit's OWN burst cast; a cast lands BEFORE the Full Burst window opens, so the +50% FB major does not apply to the cast itself, but the 10s buff windows do span the FB window
burst.explanation: 12 casts over the 180s fight in the driver's B1/B2/B3/B3 fixture; every burst-keyed buff shows exactly 12 applications per target, confirming one-per-cast refresh with no double-application.

gotchas.summary: Overheat I 'Removed upon reloading to max ammunition' is modelled as a permanently-sustained buff. This is DOCUMENTED (verbatim in unmodeled.skill2, called a hand approximation), so it is NOT a faithfulness defect and does not reduce the score — it is listed because, uniquely among grave's residuals, it is NOT primitive-blocked and both blind agents reached for the existing primitive unprompted.
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'Overheat I: ATK 15.48% UP. Removed upon reloading to max ammunition.' The schema exposes removeOnReload (S6 used it on all three tiers; S5 asserted a buffRemove with cause 'reload'), so the literal encoding is expressible today. Formula: atkPct is the ATK bucket; with a 60-round magazine the buff is stripped each reload and re-earned 15 hits later, so real uptime is ~45/60 (~75%) of her non-Prediction shots versus 100% shipped — a pure over-credit on the ATK bucket. Driver position: 'absorbed by the sustained hitCount-15 approximation, hand decision.'
gotchas.suggestedFix: Add removeOnReload:true to the hitCount-15 atkPct 15.48 effect (no new primitive needed, no measurement needed — the removal clause is literal kit text). Expected direction: small reduction in her non-window damage, which moves the board the same way as the two other tracked residuals. Enact as its own A/B against the solo anchor (1.005) rather than folded into the U19 burst-window work, since it is a non-window effect and must not be allowed to mask the window over-model.

verdictRationale: GO. Every one of the 17 kit lines is FAITHFUL (12) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (5), with zero undocumented divergences. The S5 blind's RED (24 failed) does NOT survive attribution: ~19 assertions are vacuous because the blind's fixture put crown and grave — both Burst II — in the same comp, so grave cast zero bursts (versus 12 in the driver's fixture), and every counterfactual patch targeted a non-existent ov.<slot>.blocks property against a schema whose slots are flat arrays. Both are RECON_ERRORs in the blind harness, not in the driver's override. Only two RED assertions are genuine encoding divergences, and on both the driver is the stronger position: the literal reloadSpeedPct -50 yields 131f against a MEASURED 201f reload gap (n=19, and S2b's competing refill-fraction reading is separately refuted by the observed full 60-round mags at 61.5 shots/gap), and Overheat I's removeOnReload is documented verbatim as a deliberate hand approximation. Cross-family corroboration is strong where it matters most: fable (S2b) and opus (S5, S6) independently converged with the driver on every burst mechanic and exact magnitude — burstCast not fullBurstEnter, gainPierce as a timed effect rather than whole-fight hasPierce, unscoped critRatePct 85.19, attackDamagePct 48.2 not atkPct, maxAmmoFlat 3 not maxAmmoPct, Overheat III in the Damage-Up bucket, and Reload Ratio as a damage line rather than droppable defensive QoL. Where they diverged, the driver wins on the merits twice more: S2b's 'Overheat II/III permanent once earned' ignores the explicit 'While in Prediction' active gate, and S6's derived 2.7s Heat Emission window is built on the datamined 81f reload the driver measured away. Ranked residuals, all documented and all pointing the same direction as the board's 1.104 HOT: (1) Overheat II/III full-window uptime versus the real ~2.5s/~5.0s ramp — the largest, and note for whoever enacts it that trimming durationSec to 7.5/5.0 preserves the uptime integral but not the alignment, so a start-delay or window-scoped counter is the faithful fix rather than the haircut; (2) the unmodelled Prediction-end ammo dump, ~9-11 forced 201f reloads per comp fight, genuinely primitive-blocked on both the empty-magazine effect and the status-end trigger; (3) Overheat I removeOnReload, the only residual that is enactable today at zero primitive cost; (4) Heat Emission's team buffs modelled as fight-long passives, primitive-blocked and corroborated as such by both blinds. None of these touch the measured solo anchor (1.005), because a lone Burst II never bursts and so never leaves Heat Emission. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: two engine-behaviour claims that were adjudicated by reasoning rather than by an independent instrument — that recovery events fire receiver-side (which is what makes dropping the 2%/sec self-heal safe under hard-rule 2), and that excludeSelf on the 48.4 remains the correct compensation, which it is ONLY while the Heat Emission gate is unmodelled; if a self-status gate primitive ever lands, excludeSelf must be removed in the same change or the compensation silently becomes an under-credit.
